agentic_repository_design.target_operator: Autonomous AI Agent & Human Peer Programmers
agentic_repository_design.philosophy: Agentic Repository Design: Tri-Git separation between local agent memory management, public production web releases, and private remote audit backups.

git_local_mgit.name: _mgit (Local Memory & Workspace Management)
git_local_mgit.role: Local-only repository used strictly for agentic internal memory management, workspace state, and turn-by-turn execution tracking.

git_github_public.name: _github_public (Kairos Production Axis)
git_github_public.role: Clean, secret-free production web substrate deployed to Cloudflare Pages (lex.clinic).
git_github_public.contents: kairos_mgit/ (101/, event/, functions/api/, index.html, styles.css, script.js, ARCHITECTURE.md, context.json)

git_github_private.name: _github_private (Chronos Audit Vault)
git_github_private.role: Private encrypted cloud backup containing full chronological audit trails, execution logs, and memory snapshots.
git_github_private.contents: kairos_mgit/ + chronos_mgit/ (date-sharded memory snapshots, WeDo manifests, raw transcripts)

localonly_pattern.description: Any file containing local configs, secrets, private keys, or staging logs must append .localonly before its extension (e.g. config.localonly.js, wallet.localonly.json).
localonly_pattern.linter_rule: Pre-commit secret scanner blocks public commits if keys are found in non-.localonly files.
